title: itemInterface
author: JG
description: add safe parameter conversion for all data types in item initialization; add parameter checks like UReal, PInt, etc. into C++ code; exception shall always return causing ItemClass name and parameter name
releaseNotes: Largely resolved by revision2026 step R4.4.3 and its sub-steps: the item interface converts and checks parameters of every type; a rejected value names the item class and the parameter - for instance "ObjectGenericODE2: invalid node number detected" - and the whole behaviour is recorded by parameterConversionTest.py against a committed reference. What is NOT uniform yet is the exception TYPE per kind of error; which is #2432 and revision2026 step R6.7.
